nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What percentage of global food production is wasted annually, and why is this a major concern?
nodes.answer: Around one-third of annual food production is wasted globally, which is a major concern for both developing and developed nations due to the significant impact it has on resource utilization and sustainability efforts.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable agricultural practices|Food waste reduction_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How did the reduction in ultra-processed food consumption affect greenhouse gas emissions over a 2-year period?
nodes.answer: The reduction in ultra-processed food consumption resulted in a decrease in greenhouse gas emissions of 0.6 (SD 1.5) Kg CO2eq in the maximum reduction group, 0.3 (SD 1.3) Kg CO2eq in the medium reduction group, and 0.3 (SD 1.3) Kg CO2eq in the minimum reduction group over a 2-year period.
